title: Raise the design rider mass toward 160 kg (REQ-L2) and size to the 99th percentile of both sexes (REQ-F1)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The adult anthropometry analysis (docs/research/anthropometry-adult.md) found that the 140 kg design rider in REQ-L2 is below the US civilian 99th-percentile body mass (NHANES 2021-2023: 155.8 kg men, 146.6 kg women; 2017-2020: 159.2 kg men, 155.9 kg women), and that the existing 160 kg check case is roughly the civilian P99. It also found that REQ-F1 ('5th-percentile female to 99th-percentile male') misses the largest hips, which are female (NHANES P99 hip circumference 156.2 cm women vs 144.6 cm men). Depends on: ridebelt-anthro-001 (merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Update the requirements and every dependent value so the design rider mass is based on the civilian P99 (about 160 kg) and the sizing requirement covers 1st/5th to 99th percentile of BOTH sexes: (1) REQ-L2 basis to a 160 kg design rider (state the source); (2) REQ-F1 to cover the 99th percentile of both sexes for hip/waist girth and the relevant torso dimensions; (3) re-run docs/analysis/arrest_model.py with the new mass (default and sweeps) and update load-analysis.md, including whether the 6 kN per-tether design load / 30 kN MBS and the 4 kN absorber cap still hold; (4) propagate any changed numbers to ras-latch.md (load basis, release-under-load rating), RAS-v0.1.md §4, ride-acceleration-data.md's design-mass note, concepts.md and PLAN.md 'Key numbers'.
acceptanceCriteria: REQ-L2 states a 160 kg (or justified P99-based) design rider and cites docs/research/anthropometry-adult.md
REQ-F1 covers the 99th percentile of both sexes, citing the NHANES and ANSUR II values used, and notes that ANSUR II upper percentiles are lower bounds
arrest_model.py default mass updated; regenerated arrest_results.csv and arrest_sweep.png committed; load-analysis.md results and conclusions updated with the new numbers
If the design load, MBS, absorber or release-under-load figures change, every document that states them is updated consistently (search and list them in the PR)
No other requirement changed; DRAFT banners intact
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
output: docs/requirements.md, docs/analysis/ (model, results, load-analysis.md) and dependent documents
